item: Row 399: deduced dates are never cut silently and open their exact article set
summary: upcoming_deduced kept 80 dates of a 120-day window that holds 121, ordered by date, so on a busy corpus every later date was dropped and the month grid read as empty; limit now defaults to every date the window holds and truncated says when a caller's smaller limit cut it. Each date capped its article_ids at 200 while its title counted every article, so a date mentioned by 500 articles opened an analysis of 200 against invariant 13b's exact set; the ids stay inline at 200 (payload, Plan's ruling) but are read in ONE windowed query (it was one per date) and carry ids_complete, and a date whose ids are incomplete reads its full set first from the new read-only GET /api/events/deduced/ids (the same rows, up to the analysis window's own 5000) before it opens; past 5000 the opened analysis says '{shown} of {total} shown.' (existing x12 key). No new strings; both lists unchanged.
